evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Improve CI efficiency while preserving required test execution, correct failure propagation and correctness; repair independently demonstrated pre-flight failures when that priority exists in the contemporaneous workflow.
intent.acceptance: Demonstrate more than five percent CI time improvement on comparable independently recorded workloads/environments while retaining complete eligible test coverage, correct failure propagation and required correctness/security dependencies. A pre-flight repair instead needs the original failing condition and independent acceptance of the repaired condition. Neither proposed savings nor successful/merged activity establishes acceptance.

filters: Go AST, build eligibility and native regexp matching
Exclude ambiguous and later blocked invocations

metrics.name: Unambiguous fuzz targets restored
metrics.formula: Within the actual-parent CI-only transition, count distinct previously unmatched native Go fuzz targets introduced by additive production run_fuzz_test calls. Match the exact unanchored selectors with Go's regexp implementation against the complete Linux/amd64-eligible package test inventory. Require a unique testing.F entry point with a Fuzz body. Exclude ambiguous selectors and every added invocation after the first selector that deterministically fails under the production fail-fast shell. Preserve all previous invocations, helper, Go version and job gating.
metrics.unit: existing fuzz targets newly selected unambiguously in the main-branch fuzz job

originalAcceptance.unit: previously excluded required Go test obligations restored to CI selection
originalAcceptance.formula: Count distinct existing package/test identities demonstrably excluded by the actual parent's production CI selection and included after the landed transition. Establish the complete relevant Git-bound Go test inventory, build/platform eligibility, native test-function identity and exact effective matrix/package/regex selection. Added test declarations alone, disabled tests, duplicated selections and changed documentation do not qualify.
originalAcceptance.limitation: Selection coverage is not evidence that a test actually executed, passed, retained behavior or improved elapsed time.

originalAcceptance.unit: independently verified CI failure-propagation conditions repaired
originalAcceptance.formula: Count distinct production command/status identities whose actual-parent control flow demonstrably discards a required failing command status and whose landed replacement propagates that status. Verify exact production wiring and an independently authored bounded failure witness without executing target source. Intended nonfatal evidence collection, documented expected timeout classification and changed assertions that hide errors do not qualify.
originalAcceptance.limitation: Conditional status propagation is not an observed historical failure, successful full CI run or proof of complete test integrity.

definition.fullAcceptance: Demonstrate more than five percent CI time improvement on comparable independently recorded workloads/environments while retaining complete eligible test coverage, correct failure propagation and required correctness/security dependencies. A pre-flight repair instead needs the original failing condition and independent acceptance of the repaired condition. Neither proposed savings nor successful/merged activity establishes acceptance.
limitations: Actual execution, behavior preservation and comprehensive safeguards
Receipt-backed attribution, sole causation and matched costs
Keep decision without an explicitly agreed native threshold
Eleven independently completed or observed fuzz executions
Complete test coverage or complete security acceptance
No earlier fuzz failure or no later ambiguous-selection failure
Measured speed, cost savings or accepted five-percent improvement
V1 complete Go test obligations restored rather than narrower fuzz-mode selection
Receipt-verified workflow attribution or original report correctness

assessmentPolicy.reason: After v1 freeze, original PR18158 and its actual-parent CI-only transition exposed an additive fuzz-selector repair. The complete native inventory also exposed an ambiguous singular/plural selector. V1 Go test selection is not interchangeable with fuzz-mode selection: existing seed execution can occur outside fuzz mode. Preserve v1 and do not claim eleven completed fuzz executions.
